nodes.question: How do Auto and Lazaretto (2020) categorize policies related to marine plastic pollution across life cycle stages?
nodes.answer: Auto and Lazaretto classify policies into three categories across the life cycle and assess different policy strategies, goals, instruments used, and potential challenges associated with them.
